audience: real estate agencies that run their CRM in EstatePrime

useCases.title: List active listings
useCases.text: List the listings with status and availability filters. Open one listing for its location, photos and details.

useCases.title: Look up a contact
useCases.text: List the contacts one page at a time. Open one contact to see its phones, emails and linked details.

useCases.title: Review tasks and their owners
useCases.text: List the tasks by status, then open one to see its users, contacts and tags. List the staff users.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task
useCases.text: Create a task and assign it to one or more users in the CRM.
